description: Partial update of status-page settings. Pass only the fields you want to change. Slug/domain conflicts → 409; plan-feature constraints → 403.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

domain.description: Custom domain (must be a subdomain pointing to Statuser via CNAME). Requires `custom_domain_enabled`.

is_indexed.description: Allow search engines to index the page. Requires `indexing_control_enabled` if you want to disable it.

minimum_incident_duration.description: Minimum incident duration (in seconds, 0–86400) before it appears on the page. Requires `status_page_minimum_incident_duration_enabled` to set above 0.

password.description: Password to gate the page. Requires `password_protected_status_page`.

project_id.description: Project the status page belongs to. Omitted on create, it goes to the oldest project of the account; passed on update, the page moves there together with the monitors it shows. See `project_list`.

slug.description: URL-safe slug (3–50 chars, lowercase Latin letters, digits, hyphens, underscores). If omitted on create, a random one is generated.

subscribers_enabled.description: Show the subscribe button on the public page so visitors can get emails about incident reports and planned maintenances (plus RSS/Atom feeds). Requires a plan with `status_page_subscribers_limit > 0`.

subscribers_from_name.description: Display name of the sender in subscriber emails (the From address itself stays on the shared sending domain). Defaults to the status page name. Pass `null` to reset.

subscribers_reply_to.description: Reply-To address for subscriber emails — where subscriber replies will arrive. Pass `null` to clear.

timeline_days.description: How many days the timeline on the page covers. Must be one of: 7, 14, 30, 60, 90, 180.

name: status_page_update
title: Update status page
